questions.prompt: Which overall plan matches the monotonic stack or deque approach for Online Stock Span?

choices.label: Add one for each popped stack entry.
choices.feedback: Each entry can represent many collapsed days through its stored span.

choices.label: Count every earlier lower price, even across a higher price.
choices.feedback: The span must be consecutive and stops at the first greater price.

choices.label: Pop only strictly lower prices.
choices.feedback: The span also includes earlier prices equal to today's price.

choices.label: Store price-span pairs in decreasing price order. Pop all prices no greater than the new price, add their spans, and store the combined span.
choices.feedback: That matches the selected approach. Store price-span pairs in decreasing price order. Pop all prices no greater than the new price, add their spans, and store the combined span.
